summary: I implemented the babel package across core, localedata, plural rules, numbers, dates, units, support and the messages subpackage (catalog, pofile, mofile, jslexer, extract, frontend, setuptools_frontend), fixing the behavior bugs the tests exposed. The last full-suite run I saw was 6856 passed, 5 failed, 6 skipped; the 4 zoneinfo failures need the US/Eastern link missing from this container's tz database, and test_setuptools_commands needs babel installed as a distribution so setuptools can find its distutils commands.
